mapper.select: SELECT A.club_idx, B.relaylist_idx, B.relay_name, B.relay_phone, B.relay_etc FROM BOOK_RELAY_CLUB A, BOOK_RELAY_CLUB_RELAYLIST B WHERE A.club_idx = B.club_idx AND B.club_idx = #{club_idx}
SELECT NVL(MAX(relaylist_idx), 0)+1 AS relaylist_idx FROM BOOK_RELAY_CLUB_RELAYLIST WHERE club_idx = #{club_idx}
